Game Overview

Tiny Chick puts players into a animal experience centered on help ambitious baby chicks leap through obstacles in Tiny Chick, a voxel-inspired endless runner. Master the art of timing as you launch these flightless birds skyward, skillfully navigating gaps for continuous high scores. Customize your chick's look and revel in the thrill of incremental progress.
